pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark patches with jagged, high-angularity edges and stellate extensions. Individual patches exhibit high pixel-level edge complexity across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, light-colored pathways forming a dense topological web. Junction nodes are frequent and irregular in thickness, creating a complex negative-space grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette composed of short, dark, densely packed bristles.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural discontinuity is visible in the mane line at the junction where the neck meets the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A significant localized area of textural disruption and depigmentation, appearing as a greyish-white patch, is visible on the mid-to-upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical lesion on the mid-flank characterized by a breakdown of standard pelage pattern and replacement with irregular, light-toned tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: An avian specimen (oxpecker) is vertically oriented and attached to the primary focal lesion on the mid-flank.
